v01.text: Athens, Ohio. A small college town, where his father, Jim, coached football for decades.

v02.text: By 2014, he was Ohio's Mister Football. And the only school he wanted... was Ohio State.

v03.text: In Columbus, he waited. Behind J.T. Barrett. Year after year.

v04.text: He never started a game there. In 2017, he broke his throwing hand. In 2018, the job went to someone else.

v05.text: So he graduated early. And he left.

v06.text: At LSU, he won the job. Then, in 2019, he had a season nobody saw coming.

v07.text: Five thousand, six hundred and seventy-one yards. Sixty touchdowns. The Heisman Trophy.

v08.text: And a perfect season. Fifteen and oh. National champions.

v09.text: In April 2020, Cincinnati made him the first pick in the draft.

v10.text: Ten games into his rookie season, his knee gave out. A torn ACL. A torn MCL.

v11.text: He came back the next year, and took the Bengals all the way to the Super Bowl.

v12.text: They lost by three. Twenty-three to twenty.

v13.text: Then, in 2023, his throwing wrist. Another season, cut short.

v14.text: In 2024, he led the entire league in passing yards and touchdowns. Comeback Player of the Year. Again.

v15.text: Off the field, he's always been a little different.

v16.text: The kid who just wanted the ball. The backup who never started. The quarterback who keeps getting back up.
